key_insight: LeVo 2 combines hierarchical representation modeling with progressive post-training to generate full-length songs that are both structurally coherent and high in vocal/accompaniment detail. It aims to remove the trade-off between global planning and track-level audio quality in song generation.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the challenge of generating complete songs that stay coherent over long durations while also preserving lyrics alignment, vocal-instrument coordination, and realistic acoustic detail. Existing methods either blur track-specific details with mixed-token modeling or require long sequences that weaken global planning.
method: Uses a hybrid LLM-Diffusion framework for controllable full-length song generation.
Introduces hierarchical representation modeling to better separate and preserve structural musical information across vocals and accompaniment.
Applies progressive post-training to improve stability, controllability, and musicality in generated songs.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this work offers a practical path toward higher-quality long-form music generation without sacrificing global structure. It is especially relevant for building controllable generative audio systems that need both musical coherence and fine-grained sound fidelity.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing LLM + diffusion components and how hierarchical representations flow through the system.

paper_title: LeVo 2: Stable and Melodious Song Generation via Hierarchical Representation Modeling and Progressive Post-Training
paper_authors: Shun Lei, Huaicheng Zhang, Dapeng Wu, Yaoxun Xu, Lishi Zuo
